messages:
maya: Heads-up — postmortem follow-up for the GPU surge on 3/18. Putting action items here so we can track owners/timelines.

jun: Thanks. Can we confirm which quotas hit first? was it per-customer quotas or cluster-level?

ops-bot: Incidentbot: severity 2 — GPU shortage detected at 2026-03-18T14:02Z. Auto-scaler failed to add nodes due to quota limit (projects/rdw-prod, region us-west2).

lina: Quick notes from postmortem: autoscaler couldn't provision because GCP quota cap at 72 GPUs, we needed 120. scheduler backpressure made bursts pile up.

sre-alex: Proposed remediations:
```
- submit quota increase (owner: jun) — target 2026-03-25
- add fallback scheduler policy (owner: alex) — target 2026-04-01
- conservative headroom baseline + surge buffer (owner: lina) — target 2026-03-27
- alert on sustained queue depth > 30s (owner: engjordan) — target 2026-03-22
```

jun: I can raise the quota request today. I'll paste PR and GCP ticket here when done.

engjordan: I'll add the alert and dashboard. ETA tomorrow.

lina: For scheduler policy I'm drafting a canary: reduce pack_size and increase preemptible fallback. Need someone to review perf impact.

sre-alex: @lina ping me when draft is up. Also recommend a weekly headroom runbook check for 8 weeks to catch regression.

product-ellen: We're tracking customer impact — any timeline for when Dedicated customers might see improved tail latency?

jun: If quota increase approved by 3/25 we should see immediate improvements; autoscaler changes + headroom baseline will be gradual.

maya: Ownership summary (copied to runbook): jun — quota ticket + follow-up with cloud vendor; alex — scheduler fallback code + tests; lina — headroom doc + canary; engjordan — alerts/dashboard. We agreed weekly triage on Thursdays 10am PT for 6 weeks.

engjordan: Added recurring calendar: "GPU Headroom Triage" Thu 10am PT, invites sent.

lina: I pushed initial headroom doc to docs/runbooks/gpu-headroom.md — link: https://redwood.docs/runbooks/gpu-headroom

jun: Quota ticket created: https://console.cloud.google.com/quotas/1234 — ticket 54321. FYI vendor responded asking usage examples.

maya: Great. I'll update the postmortem ticket with owners + deadlines and mark as "in-remediation". Keep the thread updated with blockers. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: Reminder set: follow-up check on 2026-03-26 16:00Z.

sre-alex: Noting recurring pattern: weekend traffic spikes + bulk retrain jobs are major contributors. Action: limit bulk retrains to off-peak windows until scheduler is patched.

lina: I'll add scheduling guardrails to internal job templates (cron windows + concurrency limits).

jun: ETA for quota approval: unknown but vendor escalated. Will update by EOD.

maya: Thanks all — closing this thread; please reply here for any mid-week blocker updates.
